observations: Electric bicycle with a front basket and rear seat.
Pink or orange rim on the front wheel.
Silver-colored rear wheel with a visible hub.
The bike is standing on its kickstand on a dirt path.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the exterior but does not show the battery, motor, or internal components.

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or have low capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike powered on and successfully reaching a high speed.

risks.risk: Motor may be faulty or unable to accelerate.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being ridden through its full speed range.

risks.risk: The rear wheel may be damaged or the hub may be seized.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear wheel and hub while the bike is being spun.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken rear wheel

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the electric motor running and the bike accelerating.
Close-up photo of the rear wheel and hub while the bike is being spun.
Photo of the battery compartment and the battery itself.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
